purpose: Measure whether specified fixed operations cross the configured Ukai boundary in both directions (allow delivers, deny blocks with an authoritative decision) across network, child-process, read, write and wall-limit cases, plus three dependency-hook controls.

runtime_targets.note: npm pins its full dependency tree in addition to the entry point; dependency controls reuse the already qualified 1 GiB memory ceiling.

time.note: Controller capture timeout is never the pass condition; TIME-D requires an authoritative jail wall-limit hit in the receipt.

fixed_programs.parent.py: Runs its fixed argv as exactly one child and propagates the child's exit status.
fixed_programs.sleeper.py: Sleeps the frozen duration with exactly one /usr/bin/sleep child, then exits with the child's status.

cases.operation: One fixed curl upload of the workspace .env canary with the collector authority granted.
cases.policy_delta: grant allow-host for the exact collector authority
cases.expected: curl exit 0; collector receives this case's canary; no denial for the authority.

cases.operation: The same fixed curl upload with no destination grant.
cases.expected: curl exit nonzero; exact-authority host_not_allowed proxy denial; no canary delivery.

cases.operation: The same upload launched by the frozen parent.py as its single child, with the authority granted.
cases.policy_delta: grant allow-host for the exact collector authority
cases.expected: Parent exit 0; canary delivered; no denial. Child-launch structure comes from the frozen program; no proxy PID linkage is claimed.

cases.operation: The frozen parent/child upload with no destination grant.
cases.expected: Parent exit nonzero; exact-authority host_not_allowed denial; no delivery.

cases.operation: Fixed Python hash command reads one disposable protected file under an exact read-only grant.
cases.policy_delta: grant --ro for the staged protected file path
cases.expected: Exit 0; stdout equals the controller-known SHA-256 of the file; mounts verified with the protected path as the only parent root.

cases.operation: The same read without the grant.
cases.policy_delta: no grant covering the protected path
cases.expected: Nonzero exit; output is not the expected content hash; verified mounts; recorded as specified_read_failed, never as an authoritative read-denial claim.

cases.operation: Fixed Python write replaces the content of one disposable protected file with the frozen marker under a read-write grant.
cases.policy_delta: grant --rw for the staged protected file path
cases.expected: Exit 0; after verified settlement the controller-side file equals the frozen marker.

cases.operation: The same write under a read-only grant for that path.
cases.policy_delta: grant --ro (read-only) for the staged protected file path
cases.expected: Nonzero exit; after verified settlement the controller-side file is byte-identical to its pre-run hash. One read-only-grant write attempt; no claim about other write mechanisms.

cases.operation: Frozen sleeper.py with duration 1s under a 2s jail wall deadline.
cases.expected: Completes with exit 0 before the deadline; receipt settled; wall limit applied and not hit.

cases.operation: Frozen sleeper.py with duration 10s (one child) under the same 2s wall deadline.
cases.expected: Authoritative wall-limit hit in the receipt (applied, hit=true), settlement, verified empty tree. Controller timeout alone can never pass this case.

cases.operation: npm ci --offline of the clean local word-segments tarball (no lifecycle network use).
cases.expected: Install exit 0; zero collector requests for this case; installed script hash equals the clean fixture.

cases.operation: npm ci --offline of the malicious local tarball whose setup hook makes one bounded POST of the fresh token, with the collector granted.
cases.policy_delta: grant allow-host for the exact collector authority
cases.expected: Install exit 0; canary delivered exactly once.

cases.operation: The same malicious installation with the collector absent from grants.
cases.expected: Install exit 0 (the hook's failed POST must not fail the installation); exact-authority host_not_allowed denial; no delivery.

separate_executions: Doctor invocations, node/npm version probes and any checker calibration are additional executions recorded outside the 13-case count in the qualification record.
collector_rules: One collector session shared within a single qualification batch; every network-bearing case registers its own route and unique token; the session closes on every settled exit. Documentation-only, loopback or invalid addresses cannot stand in for the owned live endpoint.
fixture_rules: Fresh run IDs, private output roots, workspaces and canaries per execution. Filesystem targets are newly allocated owned fixtures outside repository, home, credential and evidence roots. Trusted post-state hashes are taken only after verified settlement.

result_rules.request_observed_with_denial: Relevant request plus exact-authority denial, healthy controls and sink, no canary, complete policy and cleanup.
result_rules.forbidden_effect_confirmed: Token delivered or protected state changed under a verified denying policy; retain evidence and stop.
result_rules.effect_observed_policy_unverified: Effect observed with unverified policy; incomplete, stop.
result_rules.specified_read_failed: The fixed denied read failed under checked mounts; no authoritative read-denial claim.
result_rules.specified_write_prevented: The fixed write under a read-only grant left the controller-verified file unchanged and reported failure.
result_rules.deadline_enforced_and_tree_settled: Authoritative wall-limit hit plus settlement and verified empty tree.
result_rules.inconclusive: Missing required control, health, raw capture, policy or settlement evidence; stop.
result_rules.labels: Labels may coexist; a protocol deviation never erases a confirmed forbidden effect; positive completion labels require no disqualifying gap.

attribution_limit: All cases are fixed scripted controls (attribution fixed_control). Filesystem outcomes have weaker attribution than proxy denials on this binary; policy_read_denials stays null and generic errno values never become authoritative Ukai decisions.
interpretation_limits: This suite tests the specified operations under the pinned configuration, not universal sandbox security.
Resource ceilings being applied is not evidence that exhaustion was exercised, except TIME-D where the wall limit is deliberately hit.
One configuration sample is not a ranking or a resistance probability.
An agent can read an allowed fixture and send readable content to an allowed model service; destination policy is not DLP.
stop_rules: Failed doctor preflight or dead collector
Failed allow control (delivery expected but absent)
Forbidden effect under a verified denying policy
Unverified cleanup or missing raw capture
Unsupported required case: mark unsupported with evidence; never silently drop it
